size_definition: (xc/beta)/(xc_B12/beta_B12), exact corner extrema on catalogue enclosing domain
Y200_definition: finite spherical integral to R200; checked on a 9 by 9 grid uniform in log M and log(1+z), not a continuum guarantee
distribution: Independent linear-uniform proposals in all nine physical values, conditioned on the unchanged joint restrictions
interpretation: Same broad physical support as v1; only the base measure changes. Accepted marginals remain correlated and nonuniform. FLAMINGO fits are overlays and coverage checks, not range setters.
